mapper.sql: P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_CODE, P.PRODUCT_NAME_KO, P.PRODUCT_NAME_EN, P.BRAND_NAME, P.CATEGORY_NAME, P.SELLER_NAME, P.MANUFACTURER, P.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, P.COST_PRICE, P.SALE_PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_PRICE, P.STOCK_QUANTITY, P.SAFETY_STOCK_QUANTITY, P.TAX_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, P.USE_YN, P.DISPLAY_YN, P.DISPLAY_START_DATE, P.DISPLAY_END_DATE, P.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, P.DETAIL_DESCRIPTION, P.SEARCH_KEYWORDS, P.REG_DATE, P.REG_ID, P.UPDT_DATE, P.UPDT_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT , (SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM product_image PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY PI.REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, PI.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL FROM product_info P
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.otherwise: AND (P.PRODUCT_NAME_KO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.PRODUCT_NAME_EN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT BRAND_NAME FROM product_info WHERE BRAND_NAME IS NOT NULL AND BRAND_NAME != '' ORDER BY BRAND_NAME
SELECT DISTINCT CATEGORY_NAME FROM product_info WHERE CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_NAME != '' ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME
SELECT FROM product_info P WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}

SELECT PRODUCT_IMAGE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_YN, SORT_ORDER, REG_ID FROM product_image WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_info (PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME_KO, PRODUCT_NAME_EN, BRAND_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME, SELLER_NAME, MANUFACTURER, ORIGIN_COUNTRY, COST_PRICE, SALE_PRICE, DISCOUNT_PRICE, STOCK_QUANTITY, SAFETY_STOCK_QUANTITY, TAX_TYPE, SHIPPING_TYPE, SHIPPING_FEE, PRODUCT_STATUS, USE_YN, DISPLAY_YN, DISPLAY_START_DATE, DISPLAY_END_DATE, SHORT_DESCRIPTION, DETAIL_DESCRIPTION, SEARCH_KEYWORDS, REG_DATE, REG_ID, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{productNameKo}, #{productNameEn}, #{brandName}, #{categoryName}, #{sellerName}, #{manufacturer}, #{originCountry}, #{costPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{discountPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{safetyStockQuantity}, #{taxType}, #{shippingType}, #{shippingFee}, #{productStatus}, #{useYn}, #{displayYn}, #{displayStartDate}, #{displayEndDate}, #{shortDescription}, #{detailDescription}, #{searchKeywords}, NOW(), #{regId}, NOW(), #{regId})

INSERT INTO product_image (PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_YN, SORT_ORDER, REG_DATE, REG_ID) VALUES (#{productNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{originalFileName}, #{representativeYn}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), #{regId})
